text:
anya: quick legal ask — need a 90d export of 'who changed org KMS policies' across prod and staging. Legal wants actor, timestamp, diff-ish info, and we have to redact: user email and IP. Is that possible as a single export?

sam: possible yes. two questions: 1) do they want full request_body or just a hash + redaction marker? 2) csv or parquet? parquet preferred for size but legal might insist on csv.

anya: they asked for human-readable, so CSV is safest. request body okay to be hashed as long as we include an HMAC and a mapping escrow process. also need a checksum column.

jordan: for KMS policy changes the event stream has these fields: event_id, actor_id, actor_email, actor_ip, action, object_type, object_id, timestamp, request_body, diff, request_body_hash. We can drop actor_email/actor_ip and populate actor_id + a redaction_reason column. we need to record who approved the export.

sam: quick checklist: 1) query time window = last 90 days 2) filter action contains "kms.policy" or object_type = "kms_key_policy" 3) export path = s3://redwood-exports/legal/anya-subpoena/1998801112/ 4) redaction: actor_email -> "<REDACTED>", actor_ip -> "<REDACTED>" 5) include request_body_hash and HMAC header 6) produce CSV + manifest.json with schema.

jordan: exact psql we can run (filtered by prod/staging union):
```sql
COPY (
  SELECT event_id, actor_id, '<REDACTED>' AS actor_email, '<REDACTED>' AS actor_ip, action, object_type, object_id, to_char(timestamp, 'YYYY-MM-DD TZ') AS timestamp, request_body_hash, diff
  FROM audit.events
  WHERE timestamp >= now() - interval '90 days'
    AND (action LIKE '%kms.policy%' OR object_type = 'kms_key_policy')
) TO PROGRAM 'gzip > /tmp/kms_policy_changes.csv.gz' WITH (FORMAT csv, HEADER true);
```

anya: thanks. who needs to approve in security before we hand over to legal?

sam: need approval from eng-security lead + CISO (jordan + marie). also require a ticket in T-legal and an export approval audit entry. Add redaction rationale.

jordan: +1. also add a retention note: legal requested we keep a copy of the export for 6 months in a locked bucket; security recommends 30 days unless there's a hold. can we add lifecycle rule to transition to glacier after 30 days and restrict access?

sam: yes, lifecycle to GLACIER after 30d optional, but since legal asked 6 mo, we should set 6 months then lock. must create a separate bucket with bucket-level encryption + ACLs removed.

security-bot: export-request-created by sam at 1998801170; approval_required: [jordan, marie]; export_id: exp-1998801170; status: pending_approvals.

anya: pinging marie to approve. @marie could you review the redaction plan and approve? we need approval to proceed. :pray:

marie: (in legal thread) reviewed the scope — good with CSV + hashes. approve on condition security holds the export per retention rules. approved. :white_check_mark:

sam: ok running dry-run on staging now. will post dev log and sample (first 10 rows) here with masked values.

audit-bot: staging-dryrun-complete exp-1998801170-staging: rows=12, sample_path=s3://redwood-exports/legal/anya-subpoena/1998801112/dryrun_sample.csv.gz

sam: sample looks good, actor_id present, actor_email/IP redacted, request_body_hash present. pushing prod export now after approvals recorded.

security-bot: approval-recorded by jordan at 1998801200; approval-recorded by marie at 1998801218; status: approved.

audit-bot: prod-export-complete exp-1998801170-prod: rows=48, path=s3://redwood-exports/legal/anya-subpoena/1998801112/kms_policy_changes.csv.gz, manifest=s3://redwood-exports/legal/anya-subpoena/1998801112/manifest.json

anya: got it, downloading now. one last ask — can we add a small readme in the export folder documenting the fields and redaction rules? legal wants that for chain-of-custody.

sam: will add README.txt with schema and redaction rationale + HMAC verification steps. putting retention tag and creating ticket for lifecycle policy.

jordan: filing final audit entry and closing the export ticket. thanks all. :rocket:
